newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Budapest wheat, barley futures drop further.
newsitem.headline: Budapest wheat, barley futures drop further.

text.p: Milling wheat futures continued to drop on Friday on the Budapest Commodity Exchange (BCE), although at a slower pace than Thursday's limit-down movement.
Milling wheat futures dropped by between 20 and 340 forints per tonne for all but the May maturity, which remained flat at 25,700 forints.
Feed barley and feed wheat futures fell roughly in line with milling wheat futures, while sunflower seed remained flat for all but November.

Only the July maize position traded, with 447 lots changing hands as it rose 140 forints to 20,790. Other maturities remained steady except for December, which edged up 10 to 2,310, and July 1998 ,which went limit-up to end at 23,700.
Total grains futures turnover remained at a relatively high 1,914 lots, or 672.6 million forints, compared with 647.9 million forints, or 1,366 lots, on Thursday.
